7.t: CONFIGURATION Select the configuration function from the menu and press Start to enter. The display will appear as follows.
COIN A: 1-4 COIN(S) / 1-6 CREDITS CONTINUE COIN: 1-4 COIN(S) CONTINUE
TIME SETTING:   STANDARD   LONG   VERY LONG   SHORT
TV MONITOR TYPE: WITH MIRROR WITHOUT MIRROR AGING: OFF ON

An explanation of each of the above functions is given below: ATTRACT SOUND—sounds enabled/disabled in game over DIFFICULTY—four (4} difficulty levels available (normal, hard, very hard, easy] CABINET TYPE—deluxe or upright. Choose upright. COIN A—setting of the two coin slots CONTINUE COIN—coin setting for continuation of play HANDLE DIRECTION—change steering wheel direction (normal, normal turn-reverse, reverse turn. TARGET DAMAGE—reset, damage of criminal car is not shown continue, criminal car damage is shown
